title: Pilsner Urquell - Czech Pilsner (6PK+)
description:
This is the beer that invented the category. Before 11 November 1842 there was no such thing as a golden lager, and every pilsner brewed since is a copy of this one. Bavarian brewer Josef Groll put together Moravian barley, Saaz hops from up the road in Zatec, and the unusually soft water of Plzen, and the result was clear, golden and nothing anyone had seen before.
It still tastes like the original because they still make it like the original. Triple decoction mashing, which almost nobody bothers with anymore, builds the soft caramel malt underneath. Saaz brings the spicy, floral bitterness on top, firm but never harsh. Natural carbonation keeps it soft rather than sharp, and it finishes clean and bitter enough to make you want the next one.
Every drop has been brewed inside the brewery gates in Plzen since day one. A small parallel batch is still fermented in oak barrels down in the cellars, not for sale, but as a reference the brewmasters taste blind against the modern tanks to make sure nothing has drifted.
Alcohol By Volume: 4.4%.
Pilsen, Czechia.

Crisp and delicate non-alcoholic lager with notes of water cracker and white bread, balanced by soft floral hops and a touch of bitterness. Light-bodied and clean with a gently sweet finish.
Alcohol By Volume: Less than 0.5%
Seattle, WA

title: Karl Strauss - Red Trolley (6PK+)
description:
This Irish style red ale is smooth & medium bodied, built on layered malt with a touch of sweetness. Raisin & currant lead into a soft toffee finish.
Alcohol By Volume: 5.8%
San Diego, CA

title: Mount Peak - Rattlesnake (750ML+)
description:
This Zinfandel comes on bold & boisterous, stacking black cherry & raspberry over licorice & a crackle of Sichuan pepper. Vanilla & graham cracker undertones soften the edges without taming it, carrying through a long finish that lands with real force. Big, dark & completely unapologetic.
Alcohol By Volume: 15.2%.
Sonoma County, CA.

title: Jean Francois Merieau - Arpent Des Vaudons Sauvignon Blanc
description:
This dry Sauvignon Blanc opens on gooseberry & fresh lemon, lifted by elderflower over a wet flint streak. Fermented on native yeasts, which keeps it taut & saline rather than showy, closing on the green tea bite that runs through Sauvignon at its most classic, held here in careful check.
Alcohol By Volume: 13.5%.
Loire, France.
